configuration_source_note.finding: No dedicated Stage 10 configuration file existed in the repository at the start of this stage (verified: `find . -iname '*stage10*'` returned nothing before this stage).
configuration_source_note.resolution: Treating configs/stage9_baseline_training_config.json as the authoritative Stage 10 configuration, REUSED (not reinvented) for Model 3.
justification: That file's hyperparameters (loss structure and lambda_Q, optimizer, lr, batch size, max epochs, patience, seed, dev-based early-stopping mechanism, train_inner/dev split methodology) are model-agnostic -- nothing in it is Plain-CNN- or Model-2-specific.

It was already applied uniformly to two different architectures (Plain CNN, Model 2) in Stage 9 for a fair three-way comparison; using a DIFFERENT configuration for Model 3 would introduce an unexplained asymmetry and would itself be a more scientifically questionable choice than reuse.

This resolves the Stage 10 instruction's checkpoint-selection requirement as well: Stage 9's config already specifies an independent, non-test-set validation mechanism (dev-set L_total, from the train_inner/dev partition carved from canonical TRAIN only) -- no Level 4 ambiguity, no invented mechanism.

data.patch_cache_reused_from_stage9: results_v2/baselines/_patch_cache/{train_inner,dev}.npz -- SAME exact patches used for Plain CNN and Model 2 in Stage 9, not regenerated, for apples-to-apples comparability

training_protocol.multi_seed_protocol: none specified anywhere in the project; single seed (42) used and reported, per instruction "if only one seed is pre-specified, use that seed and report it"

explicitly_not_done_this_stage: no testA/testB evaluation (deferred to Stage 11 per instruction)
no checkpoint selection using held-out data
